what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Oman, as recorded by IDMC.
In 2024, the latest year with a figure, IDMC recorded 1590 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Oman list floods.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Oman.

when.text: IDMC records new displacements by disasters year by year, starting in 2013.
The data shows no year-end count of people still displaced.

how.text: The sources don't say where people went inside Oman.
New displacements count movements, not people, and are shown on their own chart.
